Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK FOR Comprehensive Maintenance C ontract of STULZ Make Precision Air Conditioning Sys tem at SR-II Regional Transmission Asset Manageme nt Centre (RTAMC) Regional Transmission Asset Management Center, Yelahanka deals with high ly critical SCADA data servers and has deployed 03 Nos STULZ make SEC 43 1 A 10 Tr Precision Air Conditioners. The vendor should ensure round the reli ability of the system in such a manner that design temperature and humidity are maintained inside the server room. The following are maintenance requirements 1. The periodic service of the units shall be done every 2 months. The p eriodic checking of the units shall include a. Checking of the refrigerant circuits for any leaks and rectific ation of the same to be taken up immediately. b. Checking Contactors, timers, relays cleaning and tightenin g of all-electrical contacts/connections of the control panels. c. Cleaning of Condenser Coils. d. Checking for unusual noise or vibrations in the units. e. Measurement of room temperature and ensuring the requir ed temp. f. Checking & cleaning of air filters and drainpipes g. Checking humidifier section h. Recording voltage and current in electrical panel The above checks are only indicative. If any other checks are found ne cessary in the course of operation, the same shall be carried out by ve ndor with no additional cost to POWERGRID. 2. Breakdown & Preventive Maintenance of Compressor, Condensers, Cooling coils etc as per manufacturer’s recommendations. 3. All breakdown calls shall be attended within 6 hours. 4. All maintenance requiring replacement of parts shall be attended wi thin 24 hours (Subject to normal working days). 5. All problems shall be attended and rectified, even if they require 24 hours working on site. No additional charges shall be admissible by POWERGRID on account of overtime or other charges.

6. To repair parts found defective during the period of Service Contract and in case parts are found to be not repairable, will be replaced on FR EE OF COST BASIS. Parts shall be repaired only on account of defects d ue to normal wear and tear .AND not due to erratic power supply, malo peration, physical damage, sabotage, accidents or any other calamitie s such as flood, fire or earthquake etc. The AMC Contract covers are below: - Inclusions: - 1. Compressor 2. Condenser Fan Motor 3. All Electric Parts 4. Sensor 5. Relay 6. Indoor Fan 7. Heaters 8. Controller 9. I/O Board 10. Electrical contactors 11. Evaporator Motor Etc., 12. Gas Exclusions: The Annual Service Contract does not include: 1. Replacement of consumables like Filters / humidifier /Actuator / She et Metal parts and Coil if it cannot be repaired. 2. Connectivity of all listed parts / BMS spares if need to be replaced not in contractor’s scope. 3. Motorized damper / fire damper if need to be replaced not in contractor’s scope. Terms of Payment: Quarterly Basis . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
